what_this_is: Quantity-only and provisional. The host groupings for the four conditions tested (PREANALYSIS.md, 'Conditions tested (four)'), under the owner's ruling of 2026-11-19, on the design as it stands of 2026-11-18 (the plan is a DRAFT and not frozen; every set membership here is provisional, Inference). No outcome, price, revenue or bill is read; no contrast is estimated. Built by pipeline/analysis/conditions.py.

condition_2.construction: modal EIA entity type over the utility's own filings, one value per EIA id for every year

condition_3.rule_coded: the host's own unit reports delivery-only residential sales above zero
condition_3.reported_beside_it: any unit in the host's state reports delivery-only residential sales above zero
condition_3.label: a proxy for retail choice (observed delivery-only residential activity in the cohort reference year), not a regulatory classification

source.keying_checked_2026_11_19: one row per utility id and year, filed under one state; no utility id has rows in two states in any year (0 of 66,311 utility-years); PacifiCorp (14354) files under OR only; repeated (utility, state, year) keys only for EIA's placeholder id 88888 in TX; 195 rows not observed (EIA-imputed), all in 2004 and 2005

condition_4.rule: lines 1 to 6 read the plan's one-line definition (coordinator's instruction of 2026-11-19), adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19 (D-111); line 7 (EIA-imputed rows are no report) is the agent's reading
condition_4.peak: the larger of summer and winter peak demand; zero or missing in both is no report; an EIA-imputed row is no report
condition_4.ratio: peak in the reference year (cohort - 3) over the largest peak reported in any earlier year from 2001
condition_4.groups: strictly above the median of the classifiable hosts in the estimate, against at or below it
condition_4.not_classifiable: named with the reason and left out of this condition's contrast only

comparable_footprints.ruling_of_2026_11_19: Existing permitted operational quantities may support utilization, but use comparable utility footprints over the ratio's history; otherwise mark the ratio unavailable.
comparable_footprints.history: every year from 2001 through the reference year R = cohort - 3
comparable_footprints.(i) one state: in every year of the history in which the utility (its EIA id) has any panel unit, all its units are in one state, the host's (the operational schedule is filed once for the whole utility)
comparable_footprints.(ii) no succession inside the history: no row of pipeline/electricity/succession.csv, of either action, with an effective year after 2001 and on or before R in which a predecessor is summed into the host's unit (directly or through a chain) or the host's unit is itself the predecessor; a merger wholly before the history or after R does not fail it. A unit the panel flags has_predecessors with no row naming its predecessors fails (no date can be read). Extended by the session on 2026-11-19 to the whole EIA id, the utility that files the schedule: any row in any state naming the host's EIA id as predecessor or as successor, with an effective year in the same span, also fails it
comparable_footprints.(iii) customer continuity: res_customers in panel_quantities.parquet present in every year of the history and never changing by 10% or more, up or down, between consecutive years (exactly 10% fails); a missing year, or a zero count from which no change can be measured, means comparability is not shown
comparable_footprints.source: the three footprint tests read 'comparable utility footprints' in the owner's ruling of 2026-11-19, adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19 (D-111); the 10% line in test (iii) is a convention fixed by the session before any customer series was examined for this purpose

condition_4.what_it_measures: how hard the system had been used; not spare generation or network capacity
